## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit has a `Signed-off-by:` line (Developer Certificate of Origin; `git commit -s`).
- [ ] `npm test` is green, or I describe below what I ran and why.
- [ ] New source files start with an SPDX line in the directory's license (and the MPL notice for MPL-2.0 files); `node scripts/spdx.js` passes.
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that failed before the fix.
- [ ] No existing file in `protocol/vectors/` was changed; new numbers come from an RFC.
